scope: Breeze and contractor versus agency MDX only. Shared wrapper, six other article bodies and their dates/schemas unchanged.
skills: Corey Haines copy-editing, mode B, seven sweeps and final checklist
Existing product marketing context and Tom Voice compass
Blog routing and blog-factcheck for retained technical claims
constraints: Compact personal portfolio. No fabricated experience, impact figures, new marketing blocks, stock images or repetitive FAQ. Conversations welcome; no client-project availability.

copy_checks.clarity: Breeze is organized by concrete tasks and their evaluation. Provider comparison starts with scope and the assigned people.
copy_checks.voice: First-person recommendations clearly phrased as I would; no unsupported client anecdotes or sales promises.
copy_checks.so_what: Each AI use case explains what to check before expanding. Provider questions connect to ownership, capacity, testing and handover.
copy_checks.proof: Current product facts use official HubSpot documentation. Actual portfolio cases replace unverifiable personal anecdotes. Removed general statistics are not presented as disproved.
copy_checks.specificity: Preserves source visibility, review settings, enrichment overwrite differences, subscription/credit distinctions and named delivery responsibilities.
copy_checks.emotion: Recognizable repeat tasks and project uncertainty; no fear, inflated productivity promises or pressure to purchase.
copy_checks.risk_and_expectations: Human review, defined pilots, accountable source ownership, continuity and maintenance remain explicit. No legal classification advice.
copy_checks.final: Repeated summaries, rate charts, star ratings and duplicate FAQ removed. No em dashes in revised copy. No FAQPage markup without visible Q&A.

validation.build: Passed with TypeScript and both mandatory training validators in clean temporary validation copy using unchanged lockfile.
validation.lint: No TSX/CSS changed in this pair; no new ESLint run claimed.
validation.pages: Eight blog details and blog index
validation.internal_links: Eight distinct internal destinations from rewritten pages return 200.
validation.actual_navigation: Contractor article → Account-based CRM case passed.
validation.metadata: All nine routes have expected www canonical, descriptions and OG images. Space Grotesk headings and Geist body retained.
validation.dates: Original publication dates retained; pair updated/dateModified set to 2026-10-22. Other six article texts, visible dates and schema objects exactly match baseline on every width.
validation.schema: BlogPosting and BreadcrumbList parse. No FAQPage on revised pair.
validation.visual_review: Both mobile hero crops and desktop full-page structure inspected. Full mobile screenshots retained. Global mobile availability banner wraps into its fixed-height boundary; this pre-existing shared issue is reserved for the final site-wide check.
validation.requests: All POST requests aborted in isolated Playwright session. No real form submission.

measurement.method: Article words counted in .prose-blog.innerText after fonts load, at 390 × 844. Main height excludes global navigation/footer. Same unchanged wrapper before and after. No SEO, speed or conversion improvement inferred.
